_: The articles of Japanese statutes that the paper quotes. tools/statutes.js fetches each from the e-Gov law API (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1/articles;lawId=<id>;article=<n>) and writes the plain text to verification/statutes-texts.json; sha256 is the SHA-256 of that UTF-8 text.
The law numbers were copied from cpsbvbng26-dotcom's verification/statutes.json. None is written from memory.

verification/check.js checks that every quotation of a statute in the paper occurs, character for character, in the text recorded here, and verification/check_sources.js compares each text with the copy that cpsbvbng26-dotcom recorded.
